reason: User directive. glm5.2 (hy-t2t-glm-5.2-384k-fp8-L20A-t1-v2) was retired mid-run and every other GLM-5.2 deployment in the registry is also down; Kimi-K3 was an interim stopgap and is superseded by this.

predecessors.runs/train_full_glm52: glm5.2. baseline complete (28,720), agentic-tools partial (5,381). Died 2026-09-17 12:02 when the endpoint began returning 400s.
predecessors.runs/train_full_kimi: Kimi-K3-H20-cz-GY. baseline partial (8,321), stopped 2026-09-17 17:17 when GLM-5.3 was chosen.

do_not_merge: Both stages are regenerated here. baseline works as a control only because it shares a generator model with agentic-tools, so runs cannot be mixed across a model switch. Every row now carries a `model` field, and the two predecessor runs were backfilled with theirs, so a mixed file is detectable.

endpoint_probe.chosen: concurrency 128 — clean at every level tested (Kimi threw stream errors at 256), but throughput is flat past 128 while latency keeps rising.
endpoint_probe.tool_calling: verified on this endpoint in both streaming and non-streaming mode, tool_call arguments parse as JSON in both. Unlike the glm5.2 L20A deployment, no `stream: false` workaround is needed.

scheduling_note: Launched with --max-in-flight (128 baseline, 192 agentic-tools). The glm5.2 attempt omitted it, so all 28,717 question pipelines opened at once and its rate decayed from 0.53 to 0.07 samples/s over 23h. The bound was committed in 691b66f but that run was never relaunched under it.
